You can easily customize the distortion from lighter to extremely heavier levels with the Distortion control knob on this Danelectro guitar effect pedal. The true bypass switching ensures no signal loss while you turn off the Cool Cat Metal II CM-2. Setting proper frequencies is very easy thanks to the EQ adjuster switch on this distortion pedal. The Volume knob on this Danelectro guitar effect pedal lets you find the desired degree of sound in accordance with your amp. Metal chassis, metal jacks and satin black finish make Cool Cat Metal II CM-2 a must-have for any heavy metal enthusiast. Product Identifiers Brand Danelectro MPN CM-2 UPC 0611820001261 Model Cool Cat Metal II CM-2 eBay Product ID (ePID) 78716746 Product Key Features Type Distortion Additional Product Features Power Supply Battery, AC Adapter Show More Show Less Ratings and Reviews Learn more 5.0 2 product ratings 5 2 users rated this 5 out of 5 stars 2 4 0 users rated this 4 out of 5 stars 0 3 0 users rated this 3 out of 5 stars 0 2 0 users rated this 2 out of 5 stars 0 1 0 users rated this 1 out of 5 stars 0 Would recommend Good value Enjoyable Most relevant reviews by kopchiaguitar May 26, 2017 Great sound from the Metal ll I bought the Danelectro Cool Cat Metal ll pedal as the sustain is as good if not better than higher end pedals costing 4 to 5 times as much. It has a rock solid metal casing. I also have the Danelectro Fab overdrive. I run these along with my Ibanez Modulation / Delay pedal thru my new Roland Blues Cube Stage 60. I am considering one more pedal to complete my simple pedal collection of just 4 pedals....The 4th being an Origin Slide Rig ...if I can get one soon as it looks to be discontinued. Now back to the main subject....the CM-2 works well when adjusting the amount of sustain/distortion with the guitar volume knob. It is a touch noisy but as I use it with an 87 Stratocaster I expected to have to work around that....and play at lot in the 2nd and 4th position to eliminate the hum. A friend uses it with humbuckers with zero issues. The only negative I can find is you can't use ninety degree jacks with this pedal as they have a tendency of turning the volume up or down. Use straight jacks and you are good to go.
